title.narrative: In 2021, EAPR evaluation function continued to support evidence-based programmatic and policy decision-making. EAPR effectively implemented the revised Evaluation Policy and Regional Evaluation Strategy Action Plan. As a result, EAPR delivered 16 (including three regional) evaluations. ;All MCES posts continue to be filled.; Guidance has been provided to familiarize new MCES with UNICEF rules and regulations, based on which they are expanding their scope of support to country offices, for instance to KM areas. In 2021, EAPRO (@90%) and ROSA (@92%) where the only regions with an expenditure on evaluations of greater than 80%.; KPI for quality was met.
